strengths: All 5 templates (Software Dev, Firmware/Hardware, Management/Ops, Purchasing, Bug Tracker) match the spec Appendix verbatim: titles, colors, wip limits, policy text, and done-flags all exact (templates.ts:29-240)
Forward-compatible type honored correctly: signable fields are optional, never required (templates.ts:18-19)
Palette locked via 'as const' COLUMN_COLORS with a derived ColumnColor union, so non-palette colors fail typecheck (templates.ts:1-10)
Each template has exactly one isDone column; pure client data with no server/DB storage
TDD test is verbatim from the plan and passes green (4/4)

issues.description: Plan step 3 said 'isSignable intentionally omitted'; implementer added optional isSignable and signableAssigneeId. Non-blocking — the QUALITY BAR/DELIVERABLE explicitly sanction the optional form ('signable optional/omitted, NOT required'), so this satisfies the acceptance bar even though it diverges from the plan's prose.

Plan said 'reuse the ColumnColor union' from ColumnView; implementer redefined COLUMN_COLORS locally. Acceptable since Task 3 ('Extract shared column-color map') exists to dedupe this — the local copy should be consumed when T3 lands.

The test guards only invariants (count, palette membership, one done-column, non-empty strings) and does not assert exact titles/policy text/wip limits against the spec. The 'exact content from Appendix' guarantee rests on manual review, not CI — future policy-text drift would not be caught automatically.
